newsitem.title: FINLAND: POHJOLAN SANOMAT SEES UNCH FULL-YR RESULT.
newsitem.headline: POHJOLAN SANOMAT SEES UNCH FULL-YR RESULT.

text.p: Finnish publisher Pohjolan Sanomat Oy said in a statement on Friday it expected the full-year 1996 result to be at the same level as last year's 1.7 million markka loss before extraordinary items and tax.

"At the moment it seems that no improvement can be expected in the group's operating environment during the end of the year. It is possible that advertising revenue will fall slightly further and so it will be very difficult to improve profitability," Pohjolan Sanomat said in its first-half report.
"One can expect that the group's result this year will be at the level of last year," it added.
In January-June, Pohjolan Sanomat's loss narrowed slightly to 1.97 million markka.
